name: UF-style-undertale
note: undertale — simple white-outline monster, locked to pure 1-bit black and white. 128x128. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-undertale.  (sample: seed 1496)

form.subject: a (friendly skeleton monster:1.3) wearing a (scarf:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (friendly skeleton monster:1.3) wearing a (scarf:1.2)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped' --style undertale,solo --out 128x128 --palette 1BIT --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1496
